title: PEBR-Net: Prior- and Evidence-Bounded Reconstruction Network for BTEM Signal Recovery
description: Source code of PEBR-Net, the prior- and evidence-bounded reconstruction network for noise-buried late-time borehole transient electromagnetic (BTEM) responses: training, validation and testing on the paired simulated dataset (https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.014t4), the gate-loss experiments, run configurations, environment specification and tests.
